title: YouthConnekt Africa Summit 2026 (Kigali)
overview: Eighth edition of the continental youth summit in Kigali, 25 to 27 November 2026: young leaders, innovators, creators and entrepreneurs.
program_dates: 25 to 27 November 2026, Kigali (eighth edition, theme 'Shape the Generational Mission'): reported by The New Times, 11 June 2026; not stated on the official site
deadline_text: The official site shows a 'Register YCA 2026' link; no closing date or 2026 dates are given on youthconnektafrica.org (read 12 October 2026).
funding_details: A search summary states the organisers do not provide financial assistance for delegates. Delegate applications are coordinated through national YouthConnekt chapters and the ministries in charge of youth affairs.

title: African Leadership University (ALU) Rwanda: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program, January 2027 intake
organization: African Leadership University (ALU), with the Mastercard Foundation
overview: A full-ride undergraduate scholarship at ALU in Kigali, Rwanda (BSc Software Engineering, Entrepreneurial Leadership, or International Business and Trade) for talented young Africans aged 26 and below who cannot afford the tuition (USD 3,000 to 4,000 a year). Financial aid is requested inside the ALU application for the January 2027 intake, which closes on 30 November 2026. ALU says it charges no application fee.
program_dates: January 2027 intake; the start date is not stated on the pages read
duration: A bachelor's degree: the scholarship holds for the minimum time needed to complete it
deadline_text: "Applications closes" "30 November 2026" for the January 2027 intake (ALU 'Apply Now' page, read 2 November 2026); no time or time zone is stated. The pages give no separate scholarship deadline: financial aid is requested during the application (stage 3, Finances).
funding_details: ALU (Financial Aid page): "Scholarships offered at ALU are full-ride scholarships covering full tuition and additional financial support throughout the scholars' journey at ALU (terms and conditions may vary depending on the scholarship contract/ partnering donor)."
ALU (Apply Now page): tuition is USD 3,000 a year for the BEL and BSE degrees and USD 4,000 for IBT; "Scholarships and grants are available to those with significant financial need."
ALU on its own grants (not the scholarship): they "apply to tuition fees only" and "other costs of attending ALU will not be covered by a grant offer".
participation_fee: Tuition of USD 3,000 a year (BEL and BSE) or USD 4,000 (IBT) unless a scholarship or grant is awarded
education_requirement: Applicants must first meet ALU's admission requirements, which are not listed on the pages read
nationality_requirements: Open to individuals "across the African continent" (ALU wording)
eligibility: Meet ALU's admission requirements, then request financial aid inside the application
Be unable to afford ALU tuition, with documents that prove financial need and socio-economic disadvantage
Especially encouraged: young women, refugees and displaced people, people with disabilities, and active contributors in their communities
application_process: Stage 1, a short introduction form; stage 2, additional information and documents; stage 3, finances, where you find out whether you qualify to apply for ALU financial aid (ALU Apply Now page)

potential_issues: A degree programme in Kigali, Rwanda; scholarships are limited per intake and go primarily to applicants with demonstrated financial need, so not every eligible applicant receives aid
ALU says terms vary by scholarship contract or donor, and its own grants cover tuition only
ALU warns that nobody may charge a fee to help with an application; report anyone who asks for money
action: Read ALU's Apply Now page and apply for the January 2027 intake before 30 November 2026, requesting financial aid in the finances stage if you cannot afford the tuition.
